description: This file contains functions and logic related to upgrading the firmware on MediaTek MT7623-based devices. It includes functions for full system upgrade, image checking, and configuration copying specific to certain board models and memory configurations.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a legacy full upgrade of MediaTek devices, handling partition updates and UUIDs.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatch function that calls specific upgrade procedures based on board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image before upgrade based on board type and magic number.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the device, particularly for eMMC boards.
